capability: Each overlap between artefacts gets one owner
title: One owner for every join.

hook.picture: Close: four short lines in a row, the plan, the data, the code and the output. A caption card on line one reads differently on line two.
hook.words: The plan and the build disagree.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The storyboard says one thing, the build says another.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: an engineer shipping a film or a doc site

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: the same caption copied across four lines. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, an edit lands on one copy only and the copies fall out of step.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each copy gets edited on its own.

stakes.body: The shipped version contradicts the plan, and nobody can say which copy was meant.

solution_hint: Pick one owner for each shared piece.

metaphor.body: The plan, data, code and output are four lines that share pieces. Every shared piece is a join with one owner tick and a gate that checks each copy against the owner.

steps.picture: Where two lines share a piece (captions, timing), a dashed join appears. The whale puts a tick on one side of it: the owner.
steps.words: Pick one owner for each shared piece.
steps.sound: Two tones per join; the owner tone louder.

steps.picture: A gate sits on each join: the copy is checked against its owner. Matching copies pass through with a glow.
steps.words: Copies are checked against the owner.

steps.picture: Push-in: one caption copy differs from its owner. The gate closes rust; the copy is rewritten from the owner, never the other way round.
steps.words: A wrong copy is stopped and fixed.
steps.sound: The pair beats, then the copy snaps to the owner tone.

steps.picture: The four lines sit joined, each join carrying a gate and an owner tick. A label slides onto one: seam.
steps.words: Shared pieces meet at a seam.

real_case.claim: Film gate check R1 (storyboard captions vs data.js captions) on the Type-safe film fails: 18 vs 20, with 6 text and 3 timing mismatches. Rule: each overlap gets one authority.

source.title: RESEARCH.md §3, quoting Research agenda (p5.js Explainer Lab)

honest_limit.picture: Push to the output line: a caption that exists only in the output. No other line holds it, so there is no join and no gate. It goes out unchecked.
honest_limit.words: Nothing shared it. Nothing checked it.

not_this.body: Only the overlaps you name get checked.

ending_pattern.body: Every shared piece carries its owner tick, every copy matches, and the output ships to a pod that answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: The mismatched caption copy from bar 1 now matches its owner in the same framing, and the pod's ✕ turns ✓.

end_belief.body: Give each shared piece one owner. Check copies.
